description: This file contains a report generation script for Eway Bill data in an ERP system, including data retrieval, processing, and formatting functions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to execute the report, setting default filters and retrieving columns and data.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes delivery note data based on filters, including formatting dates and cleaning text.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for supply type, sub type, and document type in a row.

methods.name: set_address_details
methods.description: Retrieves and formats address details for sender and receiver, cleaning special characters.

methods.name: set_taxes
methods.description: Calculates and updates tax amounts and rates for each row based on GST settings.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and labels of the report columns.
